answer: Require each identity to climb a work-history ladder before earning full rewards: complete 12 useful tasks in strict sequence over at least 14 epochs, each chained to the previous output hash so work cannot run in parallel across fakes. Five random peers re-run each task and must agree before credit is given. Like water carving karst, trust builds slowly; like a dune, each added identity shifts the whole ladder, forcing the attacker to redo all 12 tasks and pay the full compute and waiting time again. A crystal-clear log of tasks, reviewers and hashes exposes duplicated work for slashing.
